The '''Republic Health Administration''' was the government organization responsible for overseeing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] medical facilities, studies, and resources. Based on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Administration appointed a new acting head<ref name="Opportunity Knocks" /> in [[3642 BBY]]<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|2}}</ref>&mdash;a [[Unidentified Republic doctor|doctor]] who had developed a cure for the low-grade flesh-eating virus known as [[Zabrak Scalp Necrosis]]. His appointment prompted scorn from one of the doctor's former classmates, [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], as the man's poor medical skills and low intelligence had been notorious during their [[Time/Legends|time]] at the [[First Republic Medical Academy of Coruscant]], the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant's]] medical program.<ref name="Opportunity Knocks" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Administration was first mentioned in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', during the conversation "Opportunity Knocks" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class' companion character Archiban Kimble, known in-game as "Doc."<ref name="Opportunity Knocks" />
